When picked up, the Leaf will grant the character {0} Elemental Mastery for 12s. Only 1 Leaf can be generated this way every 20s. This effect can still be triggered if the character is not on the field. The Leaf of Consciousness' effect cannot stack.

scion_of_the_blazing_sun.name: Scion of the Blazing Sun
scion_of_the_blazing_sun.descHtmlTpl: After a Charged Attack hits an opponent, a Sunfire Arrow will descend upon the opponent hit, dealing {0} ATK as DMG, and applying the Heartsearer effect to the opponent damaged by said Arrow for 10s. Opponents affected by Heartsearer take {1} more Charged Attack DMG from the wielder. A Sunfire Arrow can be triggered once every 10s.

sequence_of_solitude.name: Sequence of Solitude
sequence_of_solitude.descHtmlTpl: When an attack hits an opponent, deal AoE DMG equal to {0} of Max HP at the target's location. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.

serenitys_call.name: Serenity's Call

serpent_spine.name: Serpent Spine

sharpshooters_oath.name: Sharpshooter's Oath
sharpshooters_oath.descHtmlTpl: Increases DMG against weak spots by {0}.

silvershower_heartstrings.name: Silvershower Heartstrings

In addition, when 3 stacks are active, Elemental Burst CRIT Rate will be increased by {3}. This effect will be canceled 4s after falling under 3 stacks.

skyrider_greatsword.name: Skyrider Greatsword

skyrider_sword.name: Skyrider Sword

skyward_atlas.name: Skyward Atlas

skyward_blade.name: Skyward Blade

skyward_spine.name: Skyward Spine
skyward_spine.descHtmlTpl: Increases CRIT Rate by {0} and increases Normal ATK SPD by 12%. Additionally, Normal and Charged Attacks hits on opponents have a 50% chance to trigger a vacuum blade that deals {1} of ATK as DMG in a small AoE. This effect can occur no more than once every 2s.

slingshot.name: Slingshot
slingshot.descHtmlTpl: If a Normal or Charged Attack hits a target within 0.3s of being fired, increases DMG by {0}. Otherwise, decreases DMG by 10%.

snare_hook.name: Snare Hook
snare_hook.descHtmlTpl: Upon causing an Elemental Reaction, increases Elemental Mastery by {0} for 12s. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Elemental Mastery from this effect is further increased by {1}. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

snowtombed_starsilver.name: Snow-Tombed Starsilver

solar_pearl.name: Solar Pearl

song_of_broken_pines.name: Song of Broken Pines
song_of_broken_pines.descHtmlTpl: A part of the "Millennial Movement" that wanders amidst the winds. song_of_stillness.name: Song of Stillness
song_of_stillness.descHtmlTpl: After the wielder is healed, they will deal {0} more DMG for 8s. This can be triggered even when the character is not on the field.

song_of_the_vigil.name: Song of the Vigil

splendor_of_tranquil_waters.name: Splendor of Tranquil Waters
splendor_of_tranquil_waters.descHtmlTpl: When the equipping character's current HP increases or decreases, Elemental Skill DMG dealt will be increased by {0} for 6s. Max 3 stacks. starcallers_watch.name: Starcaller's Watch

surfs_up.name: Surf's Up

Max 4 Scorching Summer stacks.

sword_of_descension.name: Sword of Descension
sword_of_descension.descHtmlTpl:
Effective only on the following platform:
"PlayStation™Network"
Hitting opponents with Normal and Charged Attacks grants a 50% chance to deal 200% ATK as DMG in a small AoE. This effect can only occur once every 10s. Additionally, if the Traveler equips the Sword of Descension, their ATK is increased by 66.

sword_of_narzissenkreuz.name: Sword of Narzissenkreuz

sword_of_narzissenkreuz_11429.name: Sword of Narzissenkreuz
sword_of_narzissenkreuz_11429.descHtmlTpl: In countless stories, the weapon that befits the legendary hero is also the key to opening all gates, required to surpass the climax and reach destiny's denouement.

symphonist_of_scents.name: Symphonist of Scents
symphonist_of_scents.descHtmlTpl: ATK is increased by {0}. When the equipping character is off-field, ATK is increased by an additional {1}. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

talking_stick.descHtmlTpl: ATK will be increased by {0} for 15s after being affected by Pyro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s. All Elemental DMG Bonus will be increased by {1} for 15s after being affected by Hydro, Cryo, Electro, or Dendro. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

tamayuratei_no_ohanashi.name: Tamayuratei no Ohanashi
tamayuratei_no_ohanashi.descHtmlTpl: Increase ATK by {0} and Movement SPD by 10% for 10s when using an Elemental Skill.

the_bell.name: The Bell
the_bell.descHtmlTpl: Taking DMG generates a shield which absorbs DMG up to {0} of Max HP. This shield lasts for 10s or until broken, and can only be triggered once every 45s. While protected by a shield, the character gains {1} increased DMG.

the_black_sword.name: The Black Sword
the_black_sword.descHtmlTpl: Increases DMG dealt by Normal and Charged Attacks by {0}. Additionally, regenerates {1} of ATK as HP when Normal and Charged Attacks score a CRIT Hit. This effect can occur once every 5s.

the_catch.name: "The Catch"
the_catch.descHtmlTpl: Increases Elemental Burst DMG by {0} and Elemental Burst CRIT Rate by {1}.

the_daybreak_chronicles.name: The Daybreak Chronicles
the_daybreak_chronicles.descHtmlTpl:
The equipping character gains Stirring Dawn Breeze: 3s after leaving combat, Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG is increased by {0}. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s for each of the attack types mentioned above. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.
Additionally, when the party possesses Hexerei: Secret Rite effects, when the equipping character's Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts hit an opponent, the DMG Bonus for all these DMG types is increased by {4} instead.

the_dockhands_assistant.name: The Dockhand's Assistant
the_dockhands_assistant.descHtmlTpl: When the wielder is healed or heals others, they will gain a Stoic's Symbol that lasts 30s, up to a maximum of 3 Symbols. the_first_great_magic.name: The First Great Magic
the_first_great_magic.descHtmlTpl: DMG dealt by Charged Attacks increased by {0}. For every party member with the same Elemental Type as the wielder (including the wielder themselves), gain 1 Gimmick stack. For every party member with a different Elemental Type from the wielder, gain 1 Theatrics stack. When the wielder has 1/2/3 or more Gimmick stacks, ATK will be increased by {1}/{2}/{3}. When the wielder has 1/2/3 or more Theatrics stacks, Movement SPD will be increased by {4}/{5}/{6}.

the_flagstaff.name: The Flagstaff

the_stringless.name: The Stringless
the_stringless.descHtmlTpl: Increases Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG by {0}.

the_unforged.name: The Unforged
the_unforged.descHtmlTpl: Increases Shield Strength by {0}. Scoring hits on opponents increases ATK by {1} for 8s. Max 5 stacks. Can only occur once every 0.3s. While protected by a shield, this ATK increase effect is increased by 100%.

the_viridescent_hunt.name: The Viridescent Hunt
the_viridescent_hunt.descHtmlTpl: Upon hit, Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to generate a Cyclone, which will continuously attract surrounding opponents, dealing {0} of ATK as DMG to these opponents every 0.5s for 4s. This effect can only occur once every {1}s.

the_widsith.name: The Widsith
the_widsith.descHtmlTpl: When the character takes the field, they will gain a random theme song for 10s. This can only occur once every 30s. Recitative: ATK is increased by {0}. Aria: Increases all Elemental DMG by {1}. Interlude: Elemental Mastery is increased by {2}.

thrilling_tales_of_dragon_slayers.name: Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers
thrilling_tales_of_dragon_slayers.descHtmlTpl: When switching characters, the new character taking the field has their ATK increased by {0} for 10s. This effect can only occur once every 20s.

thundering_pulse.name: Thundering Pulse

Each stack's duration is calculated independently.

tidal_shadow.name: Tidal Shadow
tidal_shadow.descHtmlTpl: After the wielder is healed, ATK will be increased by {0} for 8s. This can be triggered even when the character is not on the field.

tome_of_the_eternal_flow.name: Tome of the Eternal Flow

This Energy restoration effect can be triggered once every 12s.

toukabou_shigure.name: Toukabou Shigure
toukabou_shigure.descHtmlTpl: After an attack hits opponents, it will inflict an instance of Cursed Parasol upon one of them for 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 15s. travelers_handy_sword.name: Traveler's Handy Sword

tulaytullahs_remembrance.name: Tulaytullah's Remembrance

twin_nephrite.name: Twin Nephrite

vivid_notions.name: Vivid Notions

The two effects above each last for 15s, and will be canceled 0.1s after the ground impact hits a target.

vortex_vanquisher.name: Vortex Vanquisher

waveriding_whirl.name: Waveriding Whirl

xiphos_moonlight.name: Xiphos' Moonlight
